responsibility: Implements simple debugging and fatal-diagnostic support for the boot runtime, chiefly by formatting halt messages as Module:Function:Line:Message, writing them through StdIO, interpreting a small set of escape sequences in debug strings, and then terminating via M2RTS_HALT. It is the targeted debugging output layer used by other libraries for internal consistency failures, separate from the full exception block machinery in RTExceptions.
same_name_distinction: This file holds the concrete debugging logic: formatting Module:Function:Line:Message diagnostics, interpreting escape sequences like \n and \\, writing through StdIO, and halting. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GDebug.h, it is the implementation of those debug operations, not just their declarations.
